title: Freud's 1895 dream foreshadowing his oral cancer

tellings.quote: a dream he had in 1895 um famous dream and he spent like 14 pages of his his Landmark book

plain: A famous dream Sigmund Freud had in 1895 foreshadowed the mouth cancer he was found to have decades later, in 1923, according to the writer Eric Wargo. He notes that Freud spent about 14 pages on the dream in his landmark book The Interpretation of Dreams, and tells it to Michels as a case of a dream seeing the future.
